Every sector on one reporting period, so this is a single-period national total. What a common period cost is declared per sector: some activity is an enumeration rather than a flow over it, and some shape is borrowed from a neighbouring period. Memo items (international bunkers, off-road machinery diesel, biogenic CO2) are excluded by construction and live in each sector's own outputs. configuration S (household demand), the baseline since rc67: residential dung read from the HIES rounds' reported cake; the rest of the diverted supply has no observed destination and is outside the total - see outputs/residential_dung_ledger_2024.csv for the fate account and outputs/national_dung_variants.csv for what each destination is worth
